finalDirection: From SR-542 about 3 miles east of Deming, turn right onto Mosquito Lake Road, go 4.8 miles, then turn left onto Middle Fork Road (FR-38) and follow it about 12.3 miles to where the road begins switchbacking uphill; park there, or sooner if snow stops you. Since July 2026 Forest Road 38 has been closed to vehicles by a washout at milepost 7.
note: Batch 5 passed this before the FR 38 closure surfaced; the closure (alert start Jul 27 2026, washout at milepost 7) was confirmed from a fetched agency page in second-opinion-10, and this drive runs 12.3 miles up FR 38, past it. Wording copied from the confirmed Elbow Lake entries.
